title: PEAD Measurement Enhancement with LLMs — FinNLP 2025 (Hadlock, Roberts, Lee)
rationale: Hadlock, Roberts & Lee (FinNLP 2025, ACL Anthology 2025.finnlp-2.13) published 'Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models' at The 10th Workshop on Financial Technology and NLP, November 2025. This is directly relevant to the confirmed H163/H174 PEAD-NLP pipeline. The paper uses LLMs (beyond FinBERT) to enhance PEAD signal measurement — potentially improving on the H163 FinBERT approach or the H174 dual-filter. The H171 hypothesis (GPT-4o-mini on earnings transcripts) was deprioritized after H168 showed availability bias, but this paper takes a different angle: enhancing PEAD *measurement* (the drift prediction itself) with LLMs rather than just sentiment scoring. This note queues investigation of the Hadlock 2025 method as a potential H176/H177 variant: LLM-enhanced PEAD signal on 8-K press releases (full EDGAR coverage, no transcript availability bias). Pairs well with H163's confirmed FinBERT approach — could replace or augment FinBERT scoring with a fine-tuned LLM.

## FinNLP 2025 — LLM-Enhanced PEAD (Hadlock, Roberts & Lee)

Hadlock, Roberts & Lee (2025). 'Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models.' *FinNLP Workshop 2025*, ACL Anthology 2025.finnlp-2.13. Suzhou, China, November 2025.

Directly relevant to H163/H174 confirmed pipeline. Proposes LLM-based enhancement of PEAD measurement (the drift signal itself) beyond FinBERT sentiment scoring. Unlike H168 (transcript availability bias) and H171 (GPT on transcripts), this paper targets 8-K press releases — same source as H163, which has 100% EDGAR coverage.

**Implication for research queue**: Candidate H176 — replace H163 FinBERT sentiment score with LLM-enhanced measurement from Hadlock 2025 method on same 8-K corpus. Compare OOS WR and MeanRet vs H174 confirmed baseline (score≥0.18, WR=80.8%, MeanRet=6.22%). Low implementation risk since EDGAR coverage is already solved.

**Priority**: MEDIUM — H174 confirmed baseline is already strong (WR 80.8%); LLM enhancement would need to show measurable lift. Queue after H206/H202-XL.
